affordances.name: Add Column Button
affordances.semantic: Button to spawn a new robot column with sunglasses on the circular path

affordances.name: Robot Column Mesh
affordances.semantic: Clickable robot sentinel column that can be selected and dragged

affordances.name: Scale Slider
affordances.semantic: Slider control to adjust selected robot scale between 0.5x and 2.0x

affordances.name: Mass Budget Display
affordances.semantic: Visual indicator showing current mass usage vs capacity

affordances.name: Pool Model
affordances.semantic: Central pool.glb model at origin serving as architectural focal point

states.name: Initial Empty Scene
states.description: Scene loaded with pool at center, no robot columns placed yet, mass budget at 0/50

states.name: First Column Placed
states.description: One robot column with sunglasses spawned on circular path, mass budget partially consumed

states.name: Column Selected
states.description: A robot column is selected and highlighted, scale slider active for that robot

states.name: Multiple Columns Arranged
states.description: Three or more robot columns positioned at different angles around the pool

states.name: Mass Budget Near Capacity
states.description: Total mass used is above 40 units, approaching the 50 unit limit

states.name: Scaled Column Configuration
states.description: At least one robot has been scaled to non-default size, affecting mass distribution

states.name: Stable Architecture
states.description: Final pavilion configuration with no interactions for extended period

postconditions: One robot column appears on the circular path around the pool
Mass budget increases from 0 to reflect the default robot mass
Robot count increments to 1

action.code: const canvas = document.querySelector('canvas'); const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect(); const x = rect.left + rect.width * 0.6; const y = rect.top + rect.height * 0.5; canvas.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('click', {clientX: x, clientY: y, bubbles: true}));

postconditions: A robot column becomes selected and visually highlighted
Selected robot index is set to a valid index (not -1)
Scale slider becomes active for the selected robot
Two additional robot columns are spawned on the circular path
Total robot count reaches 3 or more
Mass budget increases proportionally with new columns

action.code: const slider = document.querySelector('input[type=range]'); if (slider) { slider.value = 1.5; slider.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', {bubbles: true})); }

postconditions: Selected robot scale changes to 1.5x
Robot mass updates to reflect scale cubed (1.5^3 = 3.375x base mass)
Total mass used recalculates with new scaled mass

action.code: for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) { setTimeout(() => document.querySelector('button').click(), i * 400); }

postconditions: Additional robot columns added to approach mass capacity
Total mass used exceeds 40 units
Mass budget display shows near-capacity state

action.code: const canvas = document.querySelector('canvas'); const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect(); const x = rect.left + rect.width * 0.55; const y = rect.top + rect.height * 0.45; canvas.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('mousedown', {clientX: x, clientY: y, bubbles: true})); setTimeout(() => { canvas.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('mousemove', {clientX: x + 30, clientY: y, bubbles: true})); }, 200); setTimeout(() => { canvas.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('mouseup', {clientX: x + 30, clientY: y, bubbles: true})); }, 400);

postconditions: Selected robot is dragged along the circular parametric path
Robot angle position updates during drag
Robot remains constrained to circular path radius

action.code: const bg = document.querySelector('canvas'); if (bg) { bg.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('click', {clientX: 50, clientY: 50, bubbles: true})); }

postconditions: All robots deselected by clicking background
Selected robot index returns to -1
Scene enters stable state with no active interactions
Scene remains stable for 60 seconds with no crashes
All state values remain valid and within expected ranges
Mass conservation law maintained throughout stability period
